title: bronze_ingest_wgi's parameters-cell comment is misleading — no Fabric parameter actually overrides p_start_year/p_end_year
description:
bronze_ingest_wgi's first cell is commented 'Pipeline parameters — overridden by Fabric pipeline at runtime', but the pipeline (per pipeline-content.json) passes NO parameters to this notebook, and the notebook has no Fabric parameters cell (the `# PARAMETERS CELL ********************` marker, per project memory on how Fabric actually serializes parameter cells). p_start_year/p_end_year are therefore permanently the hardcoded 1996/2023 values in the file — a future maintainer could read the comment, believe changing a pipeline parameter moves the WGI ingestion window, and be wrong.

This is unlike bronze_epi, which DOES receive pipeline parameters (confirmed during task-066's self-review). The fix is a comment correction, not a behavior change — unless the intent is for the window to actually be parameterized, in which case that's a bigger question for Erik, not an implicit scope expansion here.
acceptanceCriteria: The misleading comment is corrected to state plainly that p_start_year/p_end_year are hardcoded and not overridden by any pipeline parameter, contrasting with bronze_epi's actual parameterization if that helps a future reader.

No behavior change — this is a documentation/comment fix only, unless Erik indicates during review that the window should actually become parameterized (in which case that's a scope decision, not an assumption).

[IMPLEMENTATION 2026-08-18] Comment corrected. No behaviour change, as AC2 requires.

The misleading claim was verified false two independent ways, each with a positive control (per the project's negative-findings rule):
  1. No Fabric parameters cell. A parameter cell serializes as the delimiter '# PARAMETERS CELL ********************' in place of '# CELL ***...'. That marker appears ZERO times in bronze_ingest_wgi. Positive control: it appears once (line 37) in bronze_ingest_epi.
  2. The pipeline passes nothing. Parsed orchestrator_pipeline_bronze_to_gold.DataPipeline/pipeline-content.json: the bronze_wgi activity's typeProperties has parameters=None. Positive control: the sibling bronze_epi activity passes p_epi_year, and bronze_to_silver_cleaning/silver_to_gold/data_quality_checks each pass 1-4 parameters.

So the contrast with bronze_epi that AC1 invites is real and is now stated in the comment, along with both verification methods so a future reader can re-run them.

Did NOT parameterize the window — AC2 explicitly reserves that as Erik's scope decision, not an implementation assumption. Also recorded the practical consequence a maintainer needs: because p_end_year is pinned to 2023, a newly published WGI vintage does not flow in by itself. That fact is load-bearing for task-073's row-count band, and the two comments now cross-reference.

NOT committed, NOT pushed — working-tree only.

issues.description: The new comment quotes the literal delimiter string, so a naive unanchored `grep -c 'PARAMETERS CELL'` on this file now returns 1 (was 0); the correct anchored '^# PARAMETERS CELL' still returns 0. Suggest rewording to name the anchored form so a maintainer re-running the comment's own recipe loosely cannot reach the opposite conclusion.

docs/epi_wgi_ingestion.md:689 still describes the WGI notebook as 'Parameterized by date range (p_start_year/p_end_year, default: 1996-2023)' — the same misleading framing this task exists to kill. Pre-existing, outside declared files_affected (correctly not expanded into), but now directly contradicts the corrected notebook comment. Registered as FR-095.

The embedded literal delimiter inside the comment is indented, so it cannot match a line-anchored delimiter parse — but Fabric's round-trip parser cannot be exercised offline, leaving a small unverified residual.
